description: Thin TypeScript wrapper around ZEVM with a native EVM backend, viem v2 clients, and Solidity bundler plugins.
rules: TEVM is a thin wrapper around ZEVM with a pluggable ZevmBackend interface ({ rpc, close }) for custom JSON-RPC backends.
Use createMemoryClient({ backend }) or createZevmEngine({ backend }) with a custom JSON-RPC backend, or omit backend to use the native @evmts/zevm addon on Node.js 24.
Browser clients can connect to a running TEVM server over HTTP/WebSocket JSON-RPC using viem v2 transports.
Use createMemoryClient() for viem v2 public, wallet, test, and TEVM actions, and call tevmClose() when finished.
